summary: Saint Louis County tower with an octagonal cab, listed on Superior National Forest maps from 1928 to 1966 and named in a 1952 survey record; status disputed: the Minnesota list marks it standing, while the county note ends with 'Removed'.

facts.status: Disputed: Minnesota list marks it Standing; county note opens 'Standing' and ends 'Removed', with no date for either

events.note: Listed on Superior National Forest maps from 1928 to 1966; a map listing, not a construction date
National Geodetic Survey station description names the Babbitt Lookout Tower

notes_for_editor: The county PDF's Babbitt note was read in full. It opens 'Standing. MFS. Octagonal cab.', gives the 1928 to 1966 map listing, and ends 'The tower was located southeast of the village. Removed.' No removal date or cause is given. The Minnesota list (firelookout.org) marks it Standing. The story previously said both lists show it standing and that no removal was recorded; that was contradicted by the county note, so the story now reports the conflict. No build date or builder found. The county list marks ownership 'USFS?'. The 1952 survey record only names the tower. Confirm the current status with the county or site manager before publishing.
